subject: Post-call: Context & output profile for pricing (8k / 32k / 128k needs)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Hernandez <eli@flowretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Context & output profile for pricing (8k / 32k / 128k needs)

Hi Eli — thanks again for the call this morning. Recap below and a couple of asks so we can convert this into a short pilot estimate (attached: flowretail_req_matrix.xlsx and an initial Redwood pricing sketch).

1) Quick summary of what we heard from you
- Primary flows: personalized recommendations (short prompts, ~150–350 prompt tokens, ~200–500 completion tokens), and session summaries/search (longer prompts when including history — heavy tail).
- Typical session mix: 85% real-time recommendations, 12% detailed session summaries, 3% full-session exports.
- Concurrency: peak concurrency around 220 rps for recommendations; sustained batch/async jobs for exports.

2) Context & output profile (your inputs + our initial interpretation)
- Avg prompt tokens (recommendations): ~220 tokens
- Avg completion tokens (recommendations): ~380 tokens
- Session-summary prompts (when included): 2–8k tokens typical; occasional multi-document inputs that could push a single request to 10k–40k tokens depending on history included.
- Export/archival requests: single calls that need 50k+ context (rare, batched).

3) Pricing / unit economics discussion items (what we need from you)
- Monthly token volume estimate (prompt + completion) across flows — ballpark is fine.
- Desired target $/1M tokens (or a budget range) for pilot and steady state.
- Commit level you might consider for a 6–12 month reserved plan.

4) Our proposed immediate next steps
- You confirm the monthly token volume estimate in the attached sheet.
- We run a quick model mapping volumes to three commitment tiers and three context-size profiles (8k, 32k, 128k) and send back a detailed cost table by EOD.
- Plan a 30–45 minute follow-up next week to walk the numbers and align pilot scope.

Notes on tech levers (brief):
- KV/prefix caching can reduce repeat prompt cost on recommendations by ~20–40% depending on hit rate.
- Quantized model variants reduce unit cost but may impact perf on long-context summarization — we’ll show per-workload quality/cost tradeoffs in the estimate.

Can you confirm: 1) the monthly token ballpark (total tokens across flows), and 2) whether you expect >1% of requests to need >32k context on a regular basis? Those two data points let us pick the right model families and pricing profile.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Eli Hernandez <eli@flowretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@flowretail.com
Date: 2027-05-13T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Context & output profile for pricing (8k / 32k / 128k needs)

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A few clarifications from our side, inline answers below.

> Can you confirm monthly token ballpark?
We ran a quick pass with our analytics team and put conservative numbers in the attached matrix. High-level:
- Recommendations: ~120M completions/month (this includes prompt + completion tokens ~600M tokens/month).
- Session summaries/search: ~8M completions/month (prompt-heavy; adds approx 150M tokens).
- Exports/archival: ~500k requests/month but each can be heavy; treat as bursty.

Total monthly token range: 700M–900M tokens (prompt + completion) for initial roll-out. We expect growth to 2–3x within 12 months if pilot metrics look good.

> Do we expect >1% requests >32k?
Not for recommendations. For session exports occasionally (we estimate ~0.2–0.6% of all requests), but they’re batched and could be scheduled to non-peak windows.

> Budget range?
Procurement gave a pilot budget target of roughly $8k–$12k/month for the first 2 months to validate latency and quality; if results are strong, we can consider a committed plan in the $40k–$60k/month range.

Questions for you:
- How does Redwood price across context sizes for the same model family? Is there a single blended $/1M you’d recommend for our mix, or do you want to price separately by context bucket (8k/32k/128k)?
- For caching assumptions, what hit rate would you model for recommendations out of the box?

Thanks — attached is the matrix with the numbers filled and a short note from our infra lead. Happy to hop on a call Thurs morning if that works.

Best,
Eli
Eli Hernandez
Head of Platform Partnerships | FlowRetail
eli@flowretail.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Eli Hernandez <eli@flowretail.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-13T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Context & output profile for pricing (8k / 32k / 128k needs)

Eli — thanks for the numbers and the matrix, very helpful. Quick note on how we typically model unit economics and a proposed pilot price recommendation given your volume profile.

1) Pricing approach we recommend
- For customers with a dominant short-context mix and a small number of long-context bursty calls, we offer a blended model: base $/1M for the dominant bucket (8k) + incremental add-on pricing for requests routed to larger context engines (>32k / >128k). That simplifies forecasting while protecting for heavy-tail costs.

2) Example pilot pricing (non-committed, pay-as-you-go, pilot tier) — blended examples mapped to your current volumes (700M–900M tokens/month):
- Blended Pilot SKU (recommendations-dominant): $1,100 / 1M tokens (applies to baseline 8k-capable model for recommendations)
- 32k context surcharge: additional $180 / 1M tokens for the fraction of tokens that require extended context
- 128k context surcharge: additional $420 / 1M tokens for rare export requests (we trim and batch where possible)

So for an initial month at 800M tokens with 0.5% of tokens classified as >32k and 0.05% as >128k, your rough bill would be:
- Baseline (799M tokens): ~ $878,900
- 32k surcharge (0.5% of 800M = 4M tokens): additional ~$720
- 128k surcharge (0.05% of 800M = 400k tokens): additional ~$168
- Estimated pilot month total: ~$879,788 (pay-as-you-go) — note: this is an illustration of how unit surcharges scale; we expect to drive this down with reserved commits and caching.

3) Commitment tiers (6–12 month reserved pricing guidance) — indicative
- 12-month reserved (10–20% commit): target blended $/1M = $600–$800 (dependent on volume and cache efficiency)
- Enterprise reserved (>20% commit): target blended $/1M = $350–$550
Goal: if FlowRetail can commit to a predictable token floor (e.g., 500M tokens/month for 12 months), we can target a headline $/1M at or below $1,000 for the pilot and move toward $600 or lower with commits and cache optimizations.

4) Caching assumptions we’ll use for the estimate
- Out-of-the-box recommendation hit rate: 25% conservative; 40% achievable with small feature-store changes and client-side prefixing.
- With 40% hit rate, your effective billed tokens for recommendations drop ~30–35% (prompt side benefits most).

Next steps we propose
- We’ll run an output table mapping your attached matrix to the three context buckets and send a line-item estimate (8k/32k/128k) + suggested reserved-commit thresholds by EOD.
- If you’re comfortable, we’ll include a short clause for a two-week pilot credit/billing cap to protect your initial spend while we validate hit rates.

Jonas / Marissa — can you draft the pilot estimate and include a doc with cache assumptions called out? Eli — if Thurs morning works, we can review live.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
